_comment: Reviewed literal patches applied by tools/03-assemble-web.mjs when building apps/web/build.
Every entry needs: id, search (exact string in the golden file), replace, reason, and optionally
optional:true (skip instead of failing when the pattern is gone) and disabled:true (inert).
An entry whose pattern is missing FAILS the build on purpose: it means the golden file moved and
the cutover patch list has to be re-checked rather than half-applied.
The golden file itself stays untouched until the moment you flip the client to Supabase.

entries.reason: Placeholder for cutover: point the legacy api() helper at /functions/v1 and load apps/web/supabase/*.js first. Re-enable with the exact strings found in apps/web/golden/index.html.
